plan.title: Verify environment and package versions
plan.description: Check installed versions of ultralytics, torch, torchvision, timm, pycocotools, ensemble-boxes. Install/pin ultralytics==8.1.0 if needed. Verify GPU availability and VRAM.
plan.success_criteria: All critical packages at correct versions, GPU confirmed available with VRAM reported

plan.title: Explore dataset structure, annotations, and package availability
plan.hypothesis: Understanding the dataset structure and confirming package availability will inform the training approach
plan.description: Direct import of packages (torch, ultralytics, etc.) to verify availability. Load data/train/annotations.json: count images, annotations, categories. Compute stats: annotations per image, category frequency distribution, image dimensions. Check data/products/ structure. Examine metadata.json. Check if filenames contain store section info. Identify few-shot categories.
plan.success_criteria: Complete understanding of dataset structure, category distribution, and confirmed package availability

plan.title: Create train/val split, YOLO format conversion, and evaluation function
plan.hypothesis: A proper evaluation setup is needed before any training
plan.description: Write code to: (1) Split annotations.json into 90/10 train/val by image, stratified by store section if identifiable, seed=42. (2) Convert COCO annotations to YOLO txt format with dataset YAML. (3) Implement evaluation using pycocotools COCOeval computing detection_mAP@0.5 (all preds mapped to single category) and classification_mAP@0.5 (original category_ids), returning val_score = 0.7*det_mAP + 0.3*cls_mAP. Test evaluation with dummy predictions.
plan.success_criteria: Working train/val split files, YOLO format dataset, and evaluation function that returns val_score

plan.title: Baseline: YOLOv8m nc=357 at 640
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8m provides a good balance of speed and accuracy as a first baseline with 357 classes
plan.description: Train YOLOv8m with nc=357, imgsz=640, 100 epochs, batch=16. Evaluate on val split. Record val_score, detection_mAP, classification_mAP.
plan.success_criteria: Obtain a non-trivial val_score (> 0.05) establishing a working baseline

plan.title: YOLOv8l at 640 and 1280 resolution comparison
plan.hypothesis: Larger model and higher resolution improve detection on dense shelves
plan.description: Train YOLOv8l at imgsz=640 (100 epochs) and imgsz=1280 (100 epochs, reduced batch). Compare val_scores to baseline.

plan.title: YOLOv8x at best resolution with longer training
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8x with more epochs converges better for 357 classes
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x at best resolution from step 5, 200-300 epochs, patience=50, close_mosaic=30. Compare val_score.

plan.title: DINOv2 classification pipeline on YOLO detections
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2 kNN classification on YOLO crops improves classification_mAP over YOLO's own class predictions
plan.description: Build two-stage pipeline: (1) Use best YOLO model for detection, (2) Crop detections, embed with DINOv2-base, (3) Build gallery from reference product images + training crops, (4) kNN lookup for classification. Also train a nc=1 YOLO detector for comparison. Evaluate both YOLO-357+DINOv2 and YOLO-1+DINOv2 on val split.
plan.success_criteria: DINOv2 classification improves val_score over YOLO-only predictions

plan.title: SAHI tiled inference + NMS/WBF tuning
plan.hypothesis: Tiled inference improves detection of small products; NMS tuning improves dense shelf detection
plan.description: Implement sliced inference with overlapping tiles at 1280. Sweep NMS IoU {0.4-0.8} and confidence thresholds {0.05-0.3}. Try WBF for tile merging. Evaluate val_score.
plan.success_criteria: Tiled inference improves detection_mAP over full-image inference

plan.title: RT-DETR training and YOLO+RT-DETR ensemble
plan.hypothesis: Ensembling architecturally diverse models improves detection
plan.description: Train RT-DETR-l with nc=357 at best resolution. Ensemble YOLO + RT-DETR predictions using WBF. Evaluate standalone and ensemble val_scores.
plan.success_criteria: Ensemble val_score exceeds best single model

plan.title: DINOv2 optimization: model size, kNN tuning, gallery composition
plan.hypothesis: Optimizing DINOv2 pipeline improves classification accuracy
plan.description: Test DINOv2-large vs base. Sweep kNN k={1,3,5,7}, cosine vs L2. Test gallery variants: reference only, crops only, both. Try multi-crop inference (original + center zoom + padded). Select best configuration.
plan.success_criteria: Classification_mAP improvement over initial DINOv2 setup

plan.title: Advanced training: augmentation tuning and progressive resizing
plan.hypothesis: Better augmentation and training strategy improves model quality
plan.description: Experiment with: mosaic/mixup/copy-paste augmentation strengths, label_smoothing, close_mosaic timing, progressive resizing (640→1280). Retrain best model with optimized settings.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement over default training settings

plan.title: Confidence-gated YOLO+DINOv2 fusion and co-occurrence priors
plan.hypothesis: Smart fusion of YOLO and DINOv2 predictions plus spatial priors improves classification
plan.description: Use YOLO class when confident, DINOv2 when uncertain. Build category co-occurrence matrix to bias uncertain predictions. Sweep confidence threshold. Evaluate val_score.
plan.success_criteria: Fusion approach outperforms either YOLO-only or DINOv2-only classification

plan.title: Model export, size optimization, and inference speed profiling
plan.hypothesis: Models can be exported and optimized to fit within 420MB and 300s constraints
plan.description: Export YOLO to ONNX FP16/INT8, DINOv2 to ONNX. Measure sizes and verify accuracy preservation. Profile full pipeline inference time. Optimize batch processing for DINOv2 crops.
plan.success_criteria: Total model size < 420MB, inference time reasonable, accuracy preserved

plan.title: Build and validate final submission package
plan.hypothesis: The packaged submission produces the same val_score as during development
plan.description: Create final run.py with complete inference pipeline. Export all models. Create gallery file. Verify total size < 420MB. Run end-to-end on val images and confirm val_score matches development results. Document configuration.
plan.success_criteria: Working submission package that reproduces development val_score within constraints
